g.text: Selectivity, scan choice and measured timing
Three paired trials; whiskers show observed trial min-max, not confidence intervals.
The hollow point has no candidate-index use in its diagnostic plans: its timing change is unexplained.
Client timings and EXPLAIN diagnostics are separate measurements; timing decreases are not automatically index effects.
